div.h2: Device Mounts [Drilldown: Select the _time field below]

search.query: index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE a0="mount" OR a0="/bin/mount" OR a0="/usr/bin/mount" | eval arg0=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a0,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg0=if(isnull(arg0), a0, arg0) | eval arg1=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a1,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg1=if(isnull(arg1), a1, arg1) | eval arg2=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a2,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg2=if(isnull(arg2), a2, arg2) | eval arg3=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg3=if(isnull(arg3), a3, arg3) | eval arg4=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg4=if(isnull(arg4), a4, arg4) | eval cmdline=coalesce(arg0, "") + " " + coalesce(arg1, "") + " " + coalesce(arg2, "") + " " + coalesce(arg3, "") + " " + coalesce(arg4, "") | eval cmdline=trim(replace(cmdline, "\s+", " ")) | search cmdline="*dev*" | table _time host cmdline | sort - _time
index=nix sourcetype=audit_log op="PAM:authentication" exe="/usr/lib/gdm3/gdm-session-worker" NOT acct=gdm res=success | rename acct AS User | table _time host User | sort -_time
index=nix sourcetype=audit_log op="PAM:authentication" exe="/usr/sbin/sshd" res=success | rename acct AS User | table _time host User | sort -_time

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_CMD | eval Command=urldecode(ltrim(replace(cmd,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval Command=if(isnull(Command), cmd, Command) | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(host) AS host by acct Command cwd | table _time host acct Command cwd count | sort - _time
index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL comm="cp" OR comm="rm" OR comm="cat" OR comm="echo" | timechart count span=1h by comm

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL comm="cp" OR comm="rm" OR comm="cat" OR comm="echo" | join type=left uid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table uid acct ] | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(host) AS host values(comm) AS Command values(exe) AS Executable values(key) AS Key values(acct) AS User by pid | table _time host Command Executable Key User count | sort - _time
